name: pushengage-mcp
description: Send push notifications, build audiences, and view campaign analytics from PushEngage.
long_description:
Connects your AI assistant to your [PushEngage](https://www.pushengage.com/) account so you can send and schedule web push notifications, run A/B tests, build segments and audience groups, inspect campaign analytics, and manage site settings — just by asking.

No API key is needed: the first time you use a tool, the server opens your browser to the PushEngage dashboard where you click **Authorize**. The access token is stored locally on your machine (`~/.pushengage/mcp.json`, permissions `0600`) and never leaves it.

tools.name: pushengage_auth_login
tools.description: Opens a browser window to the PushEngage dashboard.

tools.name: pushengage_auth_status
tools.description: Returns the current login state: authenticated (bool), expires_at (token expiry ISO string), current_site_id, api_url, dashboard_url, and client_name.

tools.name: pushengage_auth_logout
tools.description: Revokes the current PushEngage session on the server and deletes the locally stored token.

tools.name: pushengage_list_sites
tools.description: Lists PushEngage sites the authenticated user can access.

tools.name: pushengage_select_site
tools.description: Sets the current site used by all site-scoped tools (pushengage_send_notification, pushengage_list_segments, pushengage_get_analytics_summary, pushengage_list_drip_campaigns, etc.) when no site_id is provided.

tools.name: pushengage_get_site_details
tools.description: Returns the current site's details, matching the dashboard's Site Details page: name, URL, image, timezone, geolocation toggle, and the "Powered By PushEngage" branding toggle.

tools.name: pushengage_update_site_details
tools.description: Updates the current site's details.

tools.name: pushengage_get_campaign_defaults
tools.description: Returns the current site's campaign default settings: utm_parameters (enabled + source/medium/campaign/term/content), fallback_notification (title/message/url), fallback_attributes (city/country), and default_expiry (broken into total_seconds + days/hours/minutes).

tools.name: pushengage_update_campaign_defaults
tools.description: Updates one or more of the current site's campaign default settings.

tools.name: pushengage_get_service_worker_settings
tools.description: Returns the current site's Service Worker Settings (from the Advanced Settings page), using the dashboard labels: enable_service_worker_registration ("Enable the service worker registration from PushEngage"), enable_service_worker_in_subfolder ("Enable addition of service worker in another sub-folder"), and service_worker_file_path ("Path for service worker file").

tools.name: pushengage_update_service_worker_settings
tools.description: Updates the current site's Service Worker Settings.

tools.name: pushengage_list_segments
tools.description: Lists segments on the current site, paginated (response includes `has_more`).

tools.name: pushengage_create_segment
tools.description: Creates a new segment on the current site.

tools.name: pushengage_list_attributes
tools.description: Lists subscriber attributes (custom keys set on subscribers via the JS SDK) on the current site, paginated (response includes `has_more`).

tools.name: pushengage_create_attribute
tools.description: Creates a new subscriber attribute on the current site.

tools.name: pushengage_list_audience_groups
tools.description: Lists audience groups on the current site, paginated (response includes `has_more`).

tools.name: pushengage_create_audience_group
tools.description: Creates a new audience group on the current site.

tools.name: pushengage_list_notifications
tools.description: Lists push notifications on the current site, newest first, paginated (response includes `has_more`).

tools.name: pushengage_send_notification
tools.description: Creates and sends a push notification on the current site.

tools.name: pushengage_send_ab_notification
tools.description: Creates an A/B notification on the current site with two variants (variant_a and variant_b).

tools.name: pushengage_get_analytics_summary
tools.description: Returns the current site's all-time, site-wide totals: subscribers (current active count), notifications sent, views, clicks, and goal conversions/value.

tools.name: pushengage_get_analytics_timeseries
tools.description: Returns a time series of the current site's analytics between start_date and end_date, bucketed by group_by.

tools.name: pushengage_list_drip_campaigns
tools.description: Lists the drip autoresponder campaigns on the current site, paginated (response includes `has_more`).

tools.name: pushengage_list_triggered_campaigns
tools.description: Lists the triggered campaigns (Price Drop / Inventory Alert / Cart Abandonment / etc.) on the current site, paginated (response includes `has_more`).

tools.name: pushengage_list_rss_campaigns
tools.description: Lists the RSS auto push campaigns on the current site, paginated (response includes `has_more`).

tools.name: pushengage_list_workflows
tools.description: Lists the workflow automations on the current site, paginated (response includes `has_more`).

tools.name: pushengage_list_chat_widgets
tools.description: Lists the chat widgets on the current site, paginated (response includes `has_more`).

client_name.title: App name on the authorize screen
client_name.description: Label shown on the PushEngage authorize page as the requesting app when you log in.

config_path.title: Token file path (advanced)
config_path.description: Absolute path where the login token is stored. Leave empty for the default (~/.pushengage/mcp.json). Set it to run more than one PushEngage account side by side.
